role: Enum of the sound volume categories (master, music, record, weather, block, hostile, neutral, player, ambient) with name and id lookup.
scope_reason: Client audio is presentation only: SPEC 'Java, then C, then the GPU' keeps audio outside the tick and the GPU/RL path does not need it. The oracle never starts the sound system in agent mode (SoundManager.func_148596_a returns early on Oracle.agent()), so no sound is ever played there, and the native engine has no audio code (grep of csrc/engine and csrc/play for sound/audio/music finds only the server-side pitch draws in living.c and friends, which belong to World.playSoundAtEntity, not to this package).
notes: Also used by GameSettings for the sound level options; nothing in the game state depends on it.
